record.title: Execute one frozen RF comparison and preserve its raw evidence
record.intent: Observe the physical response under verified software arms without extending the experiment after seeing its result.
requirements: Revalidate the accepted go conditions and current bench/software state, then execute only the frozen operator-authorized protocol. Preserve stock originals and calibration/identity/option invariants.

Retain raw waveforms/preambles, actual settings, source/reference observations, software hash/policy checks, timestamps/environment and drift anchors for each arm. Retain raw management traffic and recorder statistics where used.

Stop at unexpected state change, overload, acquisition/capture failure or failed arm verification. Preserve partial runs; perform only authorized cleanup/recovery and document the final software, source and host state.

Seal each run separately with hashes. Do not erase failed attempts, add ad-hoc points, change the hypothesis or repeat until a desired outcome appears. Commit and push a sanitized acquisition conclusion before a new experiment.

Preserve all four prerequisite-only A1 stops and the host-only owned-server route stop. Require independently reviewed ordinary impedance and owned host transport lifetime remedies, including server and socket termination before isolated address removal. The connect observation must fit the unchanged twenty-second total budget and prove local absence then unique DEVICE before the unchanged single metadata read. No remedy changes the 75-slot hypothesis or permits a failed metadata or waveform retry. Restore captured original impedance and settings only while framing remains healthy.
acceptance: One completed or explicitly aborted protocol execution has sealed evidence
a recorded final state and enough attribution for offline evaluation.

review.rationale: Reviewed owned transport decision prerequisite after fourth zero-record stop and host-only route stop. Same accepted stock inputs and frozen75slot RF contract remain applicable; no new data or physical acceptance follows. Acquisition waits for reviewed owned server lifetime, termination before alias removal, and complete bounded connect observation inside unchanged20secondtotal. No metadata retry, specimen daemon restart, extra reboot or numerical change is admitted.
